name: AFG Home Loans
funder: Multiple. AFG Home Loans is a white-label brand over several funders, and the policy differs per product: Retro and Link are originated and serviced by AFG Securities Pty Ltd ACN 119 343 118 (ACL 389658) — AFG's own securitised funding, and the only products with published policy. Alpha is Bendigo and Adelaide Bank Limited ABN 11 068 049 178 (ACL 237879). Align is Think Tank Group Pty Ltd ABN 75 117 819 084 (ACL 364258). Options is Pepper Money Limited ACN 094 317 665 (AFSL/ACL 286655), with loans made by Pepper Finance Corporation Ltd ACN 094 317 647. Bright is Brighten Home Loans Pty Ltd ACN 620 839 983, managed and serviced by Brighten Financial Pty Ltd ACN 628 356 669 (ACL 512386). Edge was funded by Advantedge (NAB), which stopped accepting new applications on 30 September 2025. EVERY FACT IN THIS RECORD IS A RETRO OR LINK FACT — do not apply it to Alpha, Align, Options or Bright.

assessmentBufferPct.sourceTitle: AFG Home Loans Niche Snapshot — Retro & Link, last updated 22 August 2025
assessmentBufferPct.note: The sheet's exact wording is '2% universal buffering' under Retro's key features, with no further explanation. Read as the serviceability buffer because the Retro Switch product is separately described as having a 'Reduced serviceability buffer of 1%', which only makes sense against a standard buffer. It could alternatively mean a 2% buffer applied to existing external commitments. Confirm with a BDM before relying on it. Applies to Retro (AFG Securities) only.

value.qualifier: Retro Full Doc — owner occupied and investment, inclusive of LMI. Purchases (also available to 2nd time buyers).
Retro Lite (Prime Low Doc) — 90% LVR inc LMI, max loan $2.0m. Also $3m at 70% LVR and $4m group exposure. Separate Retro Lite rates and fees; 'No risk fee or LMI applicable'.
Retro SMSF — 90% LVR inc LMI, max loan $1m at 90% ($1.5m at 80%). Residential security only; min SMSF net assets $200,000; min liquidity 5% of loan amount.
Retro Switch — dollar-for-dollar refinance, max LVR 80%, max loan $1.5m, reduced 1% serviceability buffer, clean credit and 12 months with current lender.

Retro Thrive — investment refinance only for borrowers 50 and over, max LVR 65%, max loan $2m, up to 40-year term, interest only for the entire term, clean credit history, dollar-for-dollar refinancing.
Link Premium (near prime) — 'Maximum: LVR 90% inc LMI no risk fees', unlimited debt consolidation, no credit scoring.
Link Complete (Full Doc) — max LVR 80% plus risk fees; unlimited impairments over 24 months.
Link Complete Plus (Full Doc) — max LVR 80% plus risk fees; unlimited impairments over 12 months; 30 days or less mortgage arrears in the last 6 months.
Link Lite (Low Doc) — max LVR 80% plus risk fees; ABN registered minimum 12 months; 1 form of income verification; unlimited impairments over 24 months.

Link Lite Plus (Low Doc) — max LVR 70% plus risk fees; ABN registered minimum 12 months; 1 form of income verification; unlimited impairments over 12 months; 30 days or less mortgage arrears in the last 6 months.

rules.note: No residency or visa policy is published for Retro or Link. AFG's expat and non-resident lending sits under the Bright product, which is funded by Brighten Home Loans Pty Ltd ACN 620 839 983 (managed and serviced by Brighten Financial Pty Ltd ACN 628 356 669, ACL 512386) — the Bright page states 'Loans up to $2mil and 80% lending' and names expatriates and non-residents as the target, but publishes no residency criteria and its policy is Brighten's, not AFG's.

gaps: AFG HOME LOANS IS NOT ONE LENDER'S POLICY. Every fact in this record is a Retro or Link fact — those two are funded by AFG's own AFG Securities Pty Ltd (ACN 119 343 118, ACL 389658) and are the only AFG Home Loans products with published policy. Alpha (Bendigo and Adelaide Bank), Align (Thinktank), Options (Pepper Money) and Bright (Brighten) each run their funder's credit policy, and NONE of it has been copied into this record because no public source ties funder numbers to the AFG-badged product.

The full 'AFG Home Loans Retro Credit Guidelines Booklet', the 'Retro Post Code & Security Guide' and the Link lending guidelines are all held in AFG's 'Lenders' broker portal and have no public URL. The published 22 August 2025 niche snapshot is a summary sheet, explicitly 'a high level reference document for internal use by AFG brokers and their intermediaries only' — it is publicly hosted on afghomeloans.com.au with no login, but it is not the full policy.

The '2% universal buffering' figure recorded as the assessment buffer is the single most uncertain number here — the sheet gives no explanation, and it could mean a buffer applied to existing commitments rather than the assessment rate. It is recorded at medium confidence. Confirm before matching on it.
No assessment floor rate, DTI cap, credit-card assessment percentage, HEM loading, negative-gearing add-back or HECS treatment is published.
No minimum loan amount, and no standard maximum loan amount or maximum term for Retro Full Doc or Link — only per-product caps.
No residency or visa policy for Retro/Link. Expat and non-resident business runs through Bright (Brighten), whose policy is not AFG's.

Legal identifier conflict: the niche snapshot footer reads 'AFG Home Loans Pty Ltd ABN 26 153 255 559 Australian Credit Licence 389658' while every product page reads 'AFG Home Loans Pty Ltd | ACN 153 255 559 | Australian Credit Licence 411913'. ACL 389658 is AFG Securities' licence. 411913 is recorded here as AFG Home Loans' own.

An older 'AFG Home Loans Retro Residential Lending Guidelines' PDF is publicly reachable on the AFG marketing CDN but its PDF creation date is March 2022 — four years stale and superseded by the August 2025 changes. It was deliberately NOT used.
